maria: Heads-up — AcmeCorp flagged a discrepancy: dashboard shows ~$1,200 for Feb, invoice is $1,450. Noticed the extra ~25% appears in the final line items after 22:00 UTC on 2025-02-28. Anyone else seeing a slab/ledger mismatch?

devin: Can you drop acct ID and which plan? Also what dashboard view (Billing > Usage CSV or the UI totals)? :eyes:

maria: acct: acct_0xACME, plan: business-plus. Dashboard UI > Billing > UsageSummary. Attaching the exported snippet I pulled: ```timestamp,model,tokens,unit_price,line_total
2025-02-28T21:58:12Z,gpt-mini,1200,0.0002,0.24
2025-02-28T22:05:03Z,gpt-4x,45000,0.00002,0.90
2025-02-28T23:59:59Z,gpt-mini,300000,0.0005,150.00```

ash: billing-bot ran final aggregation job at 2025-03-01T00:05:10Z per logs. Could be a post-cutoff backfill or slab reclassification on the ledger. I'll pull ingestion logs.

billing-bot: Automatic job: billing-aggregate/finalize run_id=run_20250301_000510 status=completed duration=00:02:34 affected_accounts=121

ash: quick tail from metering worker (trimmed): ```2025-03-01T00:01:48Z INFO finalize_account acct_0xACME window_end=2025-02-28T23:59:00Z slab_apply=true tokens_rebinned=300000 delta=$150.00
2025-03-01T00:02:10Z INFO ledger_write acct=acct_0xACME new_line=plan_surcharge slab_id=SLAB-3 amount=250.00```

leo: I think I see it — when plan changed mid-day we re-evaluated slab tiers post-hoc using the final daily total and then applied a surcharge line. Dashboard shows line-items as rolled up by ingest-time (first-write), invoice uses finalize-time (post rebin). That causes double-counting in user-facing UI totals vs invoice.

maria: ok that matches the timeline — customer changed from business to business-plus at 2025-02-28T18:12:00Z. Dashboard was showing incremental lines; invoice has final slab reconciliation. Is that intended behavior? Users are upset about surprise charge.

devin: Not great. Should be consistent or at least annotated. Can we reproduce locally? What's the exact rule for slab rebinning?

leo: repro steps I used: 1) create two ingestion batches with different plan_id across the same day. 2) run billing-aggregate/finalize with --apply-slabs. 3) compare usage_summary (ingest view) vs invoice_lines (finalize view). SQL I ran: ```WITH daily AS (SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens, plan_id FROM raw_usage WHERE day='2025-02-28' GROUP BY 1,3) INSERT INTO invoice_lines SELECT account_id, compute_slab(tokens, plan_id) as slab, compute_amount(...)``` That compute_slab uses the final plan_id when slab_apply=true.

priya: We need to decide: 1) Do we change finalize to respect first-write plan_id for the day (so invoice matches dashboard), or 2) change dashboard to show final reconciled totals with a note, or 3) always auto-create an adjustment/credit line and show in UI. My preference is (3) short term, (2) roadmap, (1) breaking.

maria: Customer wants a clear explanation and likely a credit. Can we quantify the delta for this account and propose a credit amount?

ash: From the logs it looks like ledger_write created a surcharge of $250.00 and rebinned $150.00 in tokens. I can run the per-account diff: `SELECT sum(invoice_amount)-sum(dashboard_amount) FROM account_rollup WHERE account_id='acct_0xACME' AND day='2025-02-28'` and post result.

ash: quick query result: difference = $250.00 (invoice higher).

devin: If it's consistent we should refund and create a postmortem. Assign to billing-ops and eng-runtime to propose a fix.

leo: Proposed short-term mitigation: when finalize finds plan changes within a billing day, emit an adjustment line tagged with `reconciliation_note` and expose it in dashboard UI with a tooltip. That way users see why invoice differs. I can PR a small flag in aggregate flow to create the adjustment line.

priya: +1. Also lets create a one-off credit of $250 and notify Acme contact. Maria can you confirm contact email?

maria: confirmed — accounts@acmecorp.com. I'll draft message: "We found a billing reconciliation that applied a final slab after your plan change on Feb 28th. We've issued a $250 credit to offset that charge and are rolling out UI changes to surface reconciliation lines."

devin: Action items: - ash to run full accounts diff (ash) - leo to open PR to emit reconciliation adjustment (leo) - finance to issue $250 credit and attach internal note (priya/finance) - maria to notify customer and confirm acceptance

ash: started full diff run; ETA 30m.

billing-bot: ticket created: BLNG-4821 "Acct acct_0xACME reconciliation credit" assigned_to=finance priority=high

leo: I'll start the PR and include tests that ensure invoice_lines = dashboard_totals when reconciliation_note exists.

maria: thanks! customer is happy with credit plan. Please add the PR/patch notes to the ticket. :thumbsup:
